label: Fault lists
subgoals: Start each primary input's list with its own opposite stuck-at fault
Compute each gate output list from its inputs' lists and values
Add the output's own local fault to its list

label: Propagation rules
subgoals: Take the union of the input lists when no input is at the controlling value
Intersect the lists of the inputs at the controlling value
Remove every fault in the lists of the other inputs

label: Strengths and limits
subgoals: Represent the lists as sorted sets or bit vectors for speed
Expect large lists near the inputs of big cones
Switch to concurrent simulation for unknown values and timing
